newsitem.title: UK: UK's Interoute to seek AIM stock market listing.
newsitem.headline: UK's Interoute to seek AIM stock market listing.

text.p: Telecommunications group Interoute Plc said on Monday it will seek a listing on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market via a placing of stock with institutional investors.
The company said it aims to exploit the deregulation of European telecommunications markets to offer a UK switching service to other telephone companies.
Proceeds of the issue will be used to further develop its pan-European network, the company said.
"The telecommunications sector in Europe represents a significant opportunity," said managing director John Mittens.
"Interoute intends to exploit this vast market which is being opened for competition."
HSBC James Capel is the nominated broker to the issue and John East & Partners is the nominated adviser.
